entities.name: San Basilio agli Orti Sallustiani
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: San Basilio agli Orti Sallustiani is a rectory church in Rome, on via Trevi in the Trevi district. It is dedicated to Saint Basil. The church is a secondary place of worship for the Parish of San Camillo de Lellis.
